'''RD-3''' was an [[SK series]] astromech droid that was with the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Part One: Master and Apprentice />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
RD-3 first appeared in "[[Part One: Master and Apprentice]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', which was directed by [[Dave Filoni]].<ref name="Part One: Master and Apprentice />
